features.label: PDAC Approved L1810
features.text: A professionally designed knee brace with built-in hinges for customized support and stability.

features.label: Targeted Patella Support
features.text: The special tubular lateral buttress keeps your kneecap in place and aligned properly.

features.label: Material Options
features.text: Choose soft neoprene for extra warmth and compression or breathable airmesh for lightweight comfort.

features.label: Low-Profile Hinges
features.text: The slim hinges offer support for side-to-side movements without feeling bulky.

features.label: Adjustable Fit
features.text: Straps allow you to customize the fit, making it perfect for all-day wear and even larger knee sizes.

measurement: To find the best fit, measure around the middle of your knee. Sizes range from XS to 2XL, and you can pick either neoprene or airmesh material. For help choosing your size, visit our Perfect Fit Promise page to connect with an expert.
